text:
Linh (support): FYI customer reported p99 regressions that only affect streaming responses (TTFB) — non-streaming endpoints look fine. Tenant: t-9321. Repro steps below, attaching sample request ids.

Chris (customer): seeing p50 ~120ms but p99 ~1.1–1.3s for streaming first byte. Non-streaming first byte ~90–150ms. Total completion time after chunks is similar to non-streaming. This is customer-facing SLO impact.

Linh (support): reproduction curl I used:```curl -i -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwd-33b","input":"short"}'``` got `HTTP/1xx` then long pause before first SSE chunk.

Raj (eng-runtime): can you paste three request ids and the root trace ids? also which region?

Linh (support): reqs: r_20280322_01, r_20280322_07, r_20280322_12. Region: eu-west-1. Traces: trace-7a9, trace-7f2, trace-81b (attached).

infra-bot: deploy `eng-runtime/flush-heuristics` to eu-west-1 completed at 2801109000 by pipeline-bot :rocket:

Sophie (eng-sre): looking at edge/proxy logs — I see many small writes consolidated by the HTTP/2 muxer. For tenant t-9321 the edge shows `coalesce=true` and `coalesce_wait_ms=180` around the time of the spikes.

Raj (eng-runtime): that matches an experimental change rolled for h2 path last week — default `flush_window_ms` was 20 -> 200 for coalescing microbursts. It helped throughput but hurts TTFB for small-chunk streaming.

Linh (support): ok — can we hotfix per-tenant? customer is on a strict TTFB SLO.

Raj (eng-runtime): yes. two quick options: 1) per-tenant override to set `flush_window_ms=20` for streaming routes, or 2) route this tenant to non-coalescing path (adds capacity cost). I can flip an override flag for t-9321 immediately.

Chris (customer): override sounds good. any risk to stability?

Sophie (eng-sre): low risk. we already have per-tenant routing flags in the config service. I can apply and watch.

Raj (eng-runtime): created config change `cfg-9862` to set `stream_flush_window_ms=20` for t-9321, deploying to eu-west-1 now. PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/changes/9862 (rolling).

infra-bot: rollout started for cfg-9862 to eu-west-1 at 2801112300.

Linh (support): applying to customer now, will ask them to re-run repro.

Chris (customer): re-tested at 2801112450 — p99 TTFB down to ~140ms, p50 90ms. Looks back to normal, thanks.

Sophie (eng-sre): monitoring metrics: edge.coalesce_wait_ms for t-9321 back to ~25ms. No error spike. Keeping on watch for 30m.

Raj (eng-runtime): follow-ups: revert global heuristic to previous optimized value for non-streaming only, add per-route flag with clear docs. I'll open a cleanup PR to add unit/integration tests that simulate tiny-chunk streaming with h2 and ensure TTFB regression doesn't recur. Ticket: RW-13402.

Linh (support): communicated workaround and ETA to customer. Customer happy for now.

Chris (customer): appreciate the fast turnaround :+1: Please loop me when global plan is ready.

Raj (eng-runtime): noted. action items: (1) add test harness for streaming TTFB (2) add per-tenant override to console (3) telemetry dashboard for `edge.coalesce_wait_ms` by tenant. Assigning RW-13402 -> eng-runtime.

Sophie (eng-sre): I'll keep the monitor on for next 2 hours and post if anything odd.

Linh (support): closing the escalation for now, will re-open if customer sees regression. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
